violations.why: On a later run of irq_zenith, interrupt 2 is already enabled (from the earlier enable_isr(2) at line 33). The higher-priority irq_indigo can then preempt between the two writes and read the intermediate value 0.

Once zenith has enabled interrupt 2, irq_indigo can preempt the task between the clearing loop and the v_quartz[TRIGGER]=1 write. It then reads v_quartz[TRIGGER] (when v_willow==1) and sees the cleared value 0 instead of the final 1.
